description: Read one card top-up of your workspace by topup_id: pending (with its checkout link), paid (the balance holds it), expired (the payment page lapsed unpaid) or failed, with the amount in US dollars and the USDC credited. Needs a Last Price credential with the price:compute scope.

topup_id.description: The card top-up UUID: topup_id on a create_card_topup result.

name: get_card_topup
